facts.text: Grandfather's Shoulder was a white-tipped active volcano on the Korunnal Highland of the planet Haruun Kal, near the capital city of Pelek Baw. Its snowmelt fed the Grandmother's Tears river.

evidence.quote: Grandfather's Shoulder was a white-tipped active volcano on the Korunnal Highland of the planet Haruun Kal, near the capital city of Pelek Baw. Its snowmelt fed the Grandmother's Tears river.

facts.text: On the planet Haruun Kal, the cloudsea was the collective term for the poisonous, heavier-than-air gases that fell to the planet's lower areas. It covered most of the planet, with the exception of the Korunnal Highland, the only habitable area because it was above the level of the cloudsea.
